title: Thermal Imaging Applications

images.caption: Gesture Classification and Mask Prediction Model

content: This work explores how low-cost, low-resolution thermal sensors can enable practical applications including privacy-preserving video conferencing, gesture-based automatic door control, and bed-exit detection. Using task-specific deep learning and generative models, these studies demonstrate reliable human activity sensing under constrained resolution and privacy-preserving conditions.
